signals: filename contains audit, quality_delta, postmortem, signoff, smoke_report, readiness_report, report
filename contains fixture, fixture_replay, replay_result, dry_run fixture
filename contains preview, candidate, output_bundle, task-specific live_probe_result, normalized_record
filename contains next_phase, next_task, queue, task, decision_option
path contains evidence_ledger, source_cache, master_index, or stores
generic connector interface, approval, manifest, capability, family, live_probe_request/result without task prefix

public_contract_requirements: consumed or emitted by runtime/API/snapshot/native/public surface/durable store
not named by task ID, prompt ID, or bundle ID
not merely next-phase, quality-delta, audit-report, fixture-replay, or planning output
control_schema_requirements: may describe audits, fixtures, previews, validators, task queues, and operating policies
must not be treated as product runtime truth
must preserve enough provenance for validators and audit packs to keep working
must have an explicit target root under contracts/schema/control when moved out of contracts

migration_rules.description: R0-03A may classify and plan only; no contract file may move until R0-03B.
Stable product boundary contracts remain under contracts/ target roots.
Audit, fixture, preview, validator, task queue, generated scaffold, and deprecated schemas move to contracts/schema/control target roots.
R0-03B must update references and provide compatibility shims or aliases where validators still require old paths.

no_goals: no source cache, evidence ledger, review queue, public index, or master index mutation
